newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market quiet, no trade-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market quiet, no trade-USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the panhandle area early on Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested. Feedlots reporting fairly good inquiry from buyers.

Last established market was $68.00 per cwt to mostly $69.00 on Tuesday. Packer bids were $68.00-$69.00, asking price $70.00. There 76,100 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 14,400 formulated cattle and 1,900 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
